items.source_en:
Mei, you gotta stop sending your injured runners my way. I don't have medical training. Best I got is staples, glue, tape, and a lot of absorbant materials. These people need more than what I can provide them, and I'm pretty sure the reason some of them haven't come back is because they died in transit to a real hospital.

Don't be cheap, Mei. Hire a damn doctor! I'm sure you can find one seedy enough for your operation on Nar Shaddaa. Hell, I might even know a guy who knows a guy.

-Lon

items.source_en:
6th Day of Helona, 7968 C.RC

Sent around the usual message to the others about recruiting. I hate to nag, but I don't know what else to do. We're way below where I'd like us to be, and if there really is another smuggling syndicate setting up shop in the Rebel Alliance, we're going to be spread dangerously thin.

At this point, I'm ready to accept any halfway decent candidate who walks into the Rock. Emma's got an eye for talent, and I trust her to weed out anyone that's unfit. If it gets the Council off my back, I ain't going to complain.

items.source_en:
I heard tell from some of the old spacers that while Taris met its tragic end, her silent companion—Rogue—endured. The barren moon had never known the life that thrived below, yet now, in the absence of its world, it remains as a lone witness to history. Some say the remains of pre-war Tarisian outposts still rest in the dust, long abandoned, but untouched by the destruction that wiped the planet clean. A secret pilgrimage for those who care about such things, if the legends are true.

During one of those rare interludes of calm, while conducting a survey of Taris’ ruins, I found time to make the trip. As they say, I was in the neighborhood. It took some deep scanning and a few misleading pings, but I found something—one of the lost lunar relay stations, still standing in the silence. To walk in the same halls as those earliest Tarisian pioneers… Unbelievable what they accomplished with such primitive technology.

I found the whole experience moving. Inspiring. I will advise my successor to do the same. We’ll make a proper tradition of it yet.

[This is an excerpt from Captain Orlan Marek’s journal.]
items.legacy_ko:
오래된 우주 여행자들로부터 타리스가 비극적인 최후를 맞이했지만, 그녀의 침묵하는 동반자, 로그는 살아남았다는 이야기를 들었다. 황량한 달은 아래에서 번성했던 생명을 알지 못했지만, 이제 그 세계가 사라진 자리에서 홀로 역사의 증인으로 남아있다. 어떤 이들은 전쟁 전 타리스의 전초 기지 잔해가 여전히 먼지 속에 잠들어 있다고 말한다. 오래전에 버려졌지만, 행성을 깨끗이 지워버린 파괴의 손길은 닿지 않았다고. 그런 것을 아끼는 이들에게는 비밀스러운 순례지인 셈이지, 만약 전설이 사실이라면 말이야.

그 드문 평온의 순간 중 하나, 타리스의 유적을 조사하던 중에 나는 그곳으로 향할 시간을 냈다. 그들이 말하듯, 나는 근처에 있었으니까. 심층 스캔과 몇 번의 잘못된 신호 끝에 나는 무언가를 찾아냈다. 잃어버린 달 중계 기지 중 하나가 여전히 침묵 속에 서 있었다. 최초의 타리스 개척자들과 같은 복도를 걷다니… 그들이 그렇게 원시적인 기술로 이룬 업적은 믿을 수 없을 정도였다.

나는 이 모든 경험이 감동적이고, 영감을 주었다고 생각한다. 내 후임자에게도 같은 경험을 해보라고 조언할 것이다. 우리는 아직 이것을 제대로 된 전통으로 만들 수 있을 것이다.

[이것은 올란 마렉 선장의 일지에서 발췌한 내용이다.]

I heard tell from some of the old timers that although the Earth suffered its sad fate, that her faithful companion Luna fared much better. Apparently, you can still find the remnants of one of the old Apollo missions. Something of a secret rite of passage for chairs of Constellation, if Banks was to be believed.

During one of those rare interludes of calm, while doing other research on Earth, I figured I could spare the time. I was, as they say, in the neighborhood. It took some serious scanning and a couple false leads... but I found it. To walk in the same place as those earliest of interstellar explorers... Unbelievable what they achieved with such primitive technology. I found the whole experience moving. Inspiring. I will advise my successor to do the same. We'll make a proper tradition of it yet.

[This is an excerpt from Sir Malcolm Livingstone's second journal.]

items.source_en:
Another battle at Geonosis today.

If they ever find out that’s where we got the original plans for Project Stardust, things might get a little more complicated here.

Hopefully, the Republic has covered their tracks. At least I would assume they did.

I do wonder though, what if this was their plan all along? Were they just looking for an excuse to enter war?

They had a Kaminoan clone army up their sleeve the entire time. I’m no clone expert but a clone army of that magnitude had to take at least a decade to create.
items.legacy_ko:
오늘 지오노시스에서 또 한 번의 격전이 벌어졌다.

우리가 스타더스트 프로젝트의 최초 설계도를 입수한 곳이 바로 그 행성이라는 걸 저들이 알게 된다면, 이곳의 판세도 걷잡을 수 없이 꼬여버릴 것이다.

공화국 녀석들이 자신들의 흔적을 완벽하게 지워놓았기를 바랄 뿐이다. 적어도 나는 그렇게 믿고 싶다.

하지만 한편으로는 의문이 든다. 설마 이 모든 게 애초부터 그들이 짜놓은 판은 아니었을까? 그저 전쟁에 개입할 그럴싸한 구실을 찾고 있었던 건 아닐까?

그들은 처음부터 카미노산 클론 군대를 소매 속에 숨겨두고 있었다. 내가 비록 클론 기술 전문가는 아니지만, 그 정도 규모의 거대한 군대를 건조하려면 최소 10년은 족히 걸렸을 텐데 말이다.

locations.vanilla_source_en:
Project Log. Doctor Judith Tatienne. I watched the Grav Drive test from the Moon today. It was the first time we were able to talk to the team at Nova Galactic directly.

So many things were under wraps before, but now everyone wants all the publicity they can get.

I'm already seeing proposals for manufacturing hundreds of drives. Expeditions to Alpha Centauri and beyond.

It's all so overwhelming... and worrying. It could take years, decades, before we know what all the side effects of operating a Grav Drive can be. But no one wants to hear that right now. 

Like a bunch of pioneers, racing towards the edges of the frontier without knowing about the grizzly bears in the mountains...

locations.vanilla_source_en:
It's happened!

The message was short - a simple request for information regarding the state of things in New Atlantis - but filled me with relief nonetheless. 

House Va'ruun has contacted me at long last!

I had been forced to harden my heart to the possibility that I may never hear from my people again. Today's message assuaged that fear.

Though their intentions remain unclear, I am comforted by House Va'ruun's willingness to reengage in communication. I am hopeful that it signifies Dazra's willingness to return to more earnest attempts at diplomacy with the United Colonies. 

Great Serpent, you answer my prayers at last. I stand firm in my belief that it will be at my side as I continue to serve House Va'ruun's interests in New Atlantis. May his celestial light bathe my people, and those we once stood against, and help to usher in an era of harmony at last.

items.source_en:
Seeking a highly motivated individual to assist the Executive in charge of Mining Operations in day-to-day responsibilities. Prior executive assistant experience preferred, but not necessary. Must be willing to relocate to Geonosis Excavation Site. Internship is unpaid, with option for permanant role at end of contract.

Duties and Responsibilities:
- Providing administrative assistance, which may include drafting and editing communications on the executive's behalf, and keeping memos
- Managing the executive's daily calendar
- Organizing meetings and appointments
- Performing minor accounting

Required Skills and Qualifications:
- Strong interpersonal skills
- Written and verbal communication skills
- Time management and organizational skills
- Ability to proactively solve problems and make decisions in the interest of the executive
- Ability to multitask
